issue.title: stitch lifecycle close test fails with unreadable bead status
issue.description: During commit_repair module-splitting verification at HEAD 2863ed2f19a2431baeff25cca3f943f44e3e81c8, just test-scoped escalated and ran 1,238 tests; it failed only tests/test_commit_workflow_bead_lifecycle_e2e.py::test_stitch_create_requires_keep_then_closes_only_assigned_phase with unreadable_bead_status when the close action tried to read the assigned bead status. I reran that exact node immediately with just test and it failed the same way. The local diff only splits src/sase/finalizers/commit_repair.py into helper modules, and the focused commit-repair tests pass, so this appears to be a separate deterministic stitch/bead lifecycle failure. Related closed task sase-hc changed this area by moving commit hook close handling to a status read, but its underlying defect was premature close rather than unreadable status.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: The exact pytest node failed again immediately on the same unchanged tree after the escalated test-scoped failure, with the same unreadable_bead_status error.
